in_marathi.name: Avay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Avasa' meaning 'peaceful' and 'Avani' meaning 'river'. The name 'Avay' is often associated with the peaceful flow of a river and represents a calm and serene personality.
